build_discrete_actor_critic_head: build a DiscreteActorCriticHead module with MLP policy and value heads for discrete action spaces
build_discrete_actor_critic_rnd_head: build a DiscreteActorCriticRNDHead module with separate extrinsic and intrinsic value heads for RND

run_forward_rnd_head: run the forward pass of DiscreteActorCriticRNDHead to get log-probabilities, extrinsic and intrinsic values
